facts.anchor: The British said it was hallucinations caused by smoke inhalation. A few police officers were sent round to poke in the piles of offerings, half-heartedly looking for opium resin.
facts.fact: 火灾后无人再谈那场超自然搏斗：英方称众人是吸入烟雾产生幻觉，派了几名警察到供品堆里半心半意翻找鸦片膏，想把事情归为吸毒。

facts.anchor: Any moment now she would hear Por Por’s familiar shuffle up the path. The scrape of her sandals and the huffing noise the old woman made when she was disappointed.
facts.fact: Kiamling 躲在家中拒不承认山上发生的事，一直等 Por Por 熟悉的脚步声、凉鞋刮地声和失望时的哼哼声，等门被推开、等挨骂（忘带剑、浪费真气）。

facts.anchor: But it was merely Mr Soon. His shop had miraculously survived the worst of the damage and he wanted more protection put in place. He would pay extra, of course.
facts.fact: 来敲门的是 Soon 先生：他的铺子奇迹般躲过最重的损毁，他要加装防护、愿意多付钱，还想要一件随身戴的护身符，并问 Por Por 在哪、是否在养伤。

facts.anchor: “Resting, yes. Meditating and learning about this new foe. Indisposed at present.” She came to stand beside her big sister, squeezing her hand.
facts.fact: 静玲抢在说不出话的姐姐前面圆谎：婆婆在“休息、打坐、研究这个新对手，暂时不便见客”，并站到姐姐身边握住她的手，示意“我们一起扛”。

facts.anchor: Wrapped in an old blanket was Por Por’s coin sword. Or what was left of it. It had broken when she had struck the shadow beast. The coins had fused together in solid lumps
facts.fact: 静玲把旧毯子包着的东西摔在桌上：是 Por Por 的铜钱剑残骸——她击打影兽时剑已折断，铜钱熔成硬块、烧焦的木芯化成灰，已不可用。

facts.anchor: “We could write to the yiugwai hunters in Canton. One of them would come to help.”
facts.fact: 静玲低声提议写信给广州的义庄猎人（yiugwai hunters），请一个来帮忙；Kiamling 厉声说“不！”，叫她记住婆婆一直说的话。

facts.anchor: She would never explain to them why they could not go back, but the sisters understood that there was a good reason why they had fled in the middle of the night five years ago.
facts.fact: 婆婆从不解释为何不能回广州，但姐妹俩明白五年前她们半夜出逃是有充分理由的。

facts.anchor: Her deception would not hold under the scrutiny. Not to mention that they would take over, confirm the locals’ belief that she was not ready.
facts.fact: Kiamling 也不愿别的猎人来：她的谎话经不起审视，来人会接管，坐实本地人“她还没准备好”的看法，也会让欧家猎人因是女人而逊色的偏见成真——婆婆绝不会原谅她。

facts.anchor: A white snake demon had made its home within the warehouse walls, and the dock staff were refusing to shift boxes until it had been dealt with.
facts.fact: 货仓的活：白蛇精在仓墙里安了家，码头工人拒绝搬箱，非要先处理掉它；商人因此紧急求助。

facts.anchor: Kiamling bought a small clay jar of realgar wine from the inn, decanting the whole thing into an unremarkable teapot.
facts.fact: Kiamling 从客栈买了一小坛雄黄酒，把整坛倒进一只不起眼的茶壶，带到仓前石阶上请“商人妻”喝。

facts.anchor: Realgar was popular during the Dragonboat Festival, but it was also sprinkled in the corners of houses as a rodent deterrent. There were, after all, traces of arsenic in it.
facts.fact: 雄黄端午常用，也被撒在墙角驱鼠——它含砷，正是蛇精的克星；这解释了那杯“酒”为何能破她的化身。

facts.anchor: She crumpled to the ground, her loose clothing peeling away as her body stretched out. A long white snake slid from the folds of the fabric.
facts.fact: “商人妻”喝下后眼睛瞪大、掐喉抓挠，倒地时宽松衣服褪落，一条白蛇从衣褶中滑出：她就是蛇精，真气被雄黄暂时封住。

facts.anchor: Kiamling threw a fu talisman down on her, the words of banishment already written there.
facts.fact: 蛇精痉挛瘫软后，Kiamling 把早已写好驱逐词的符掷在她身上，宣判“一百年内不得回此岛”；蛇精哀求“你不明白”，她不予理会。

facts.anchor: “I’m in charge now, Jing-Jing. Honestly, I think Por Por must’ve knocked her head one too many times. Making us live like paupers.
facts.fact: 周末在客栈，Kiamling 吃脆皮烧肉配白饭、喝 mau toi，自称“现在我说了算”，说婆婆准是脑袋撞了太多次才让他们过得像穷人——结果那酒难喝得让她皱眉。

facts.anchor: That it was faster to lop off the heads of the geongsi with a coin sword than shepherd them with handbells back to their graves.
facts.fact: 她开始走捷径：用铜钱剑砍掉僵尸（geongsi）的头，比摇手铃把它们引回坟墓快得多；不必再听鬼魂诉冤，睡眠多了，本地人还夸她高效。

facts.anchor: It was the awkward Englishman, Archie Redferne. “Princesses, good morning,” he said in passable Cantonese.
facts.fact: 笨拙的英国人 Archie Redferne 来到桌边，用还算过得去的粤语说“公主们，早上好”——既称她们公主又把时辰问候错了，Kiamling 笑得米饭喷了一桌。

facts.anchor: “I’ve had two years’ language training at one of the best colleges in London. But the natives are proving incomprehensible.
facts.fact: 他澄清他要的是“生意上的提议”——请她教粤语，并说自己在伦敦最好的学院受过两年语言训练，却仍觉得本地人难以听懂。

facts.anchor: A piece of paper was thrust across the table. A name and address. “Just in case you change your mind,” Jingling said.
facts.fact: 静玲把写着姓名和地址的纸推过桌，说“万一你改主意”；地址是政府大楼里的一间办公室，Kiamling 拇指蹭糊了英文名首字母 A，骂他“天真的傻瓜”，却仍把纸折好收进衣袋。
